translations.text: Lord, to you I will confess all my sins and misdeeds: all that I ever spoke wrongly, did wrongly, or thought wrongly,
in words and deeds and thoughts, whether I remember it or do not remember it, whether I did it knowingly or unknowingly, under compulsion or without compulsion, sleeping or waking:
false oaths and lies, covetous desires and unrighteous deceit, fornications in whatever way I committed them, and unrighteous sinful lusts in food, in drink, and in improper sleep:

that you, Lord, may deign to grant me salvation and grace, that I may stand unashamed before your eyes, and that in this world I may have repentance and penance for my misdeeds, in such measure as your mercies are, almighty Lord.
